episode_notes: A lighthearted IT office romantic comedy following Shannu, an ambitious software developer, his quirky comic-book-obsessed teammates, and the arrival of a bubbly new hire, Vaishnavi. The humor revolves around workplace banter, fake excuses to the manager, and awkward romantic tension as Shannu tries to play it cool around Vaishnavi.

episode_summary.episode_notes: A lighthearted IT office romantic comedy following Shannu, an ambitious software developer, his quirky comic-book-obsessed teammates, and the arrival of a bubbly new hire, Vaishnavi. The humor revolves around workplace banter, fake excuses to the manager, and awkward romantic tension as Shannu tries to play it cool around Vaishnavi.

moment_table.why: After Shannu concocts an absurd lie about helping Elon Musk start a SpaceX rocket and manager Arvind promises to buy him lunch, Shannu delivers a sharp comeback calling out the manager's fake promise.
When Shannu claims he talks to girls by pointing at Harika, DC Don ruthlessly trolls that she is only female by appearance and actually a tomboy.
When Vaishnavi dramatically takes floor blessings and boasts about the plans she made to secure a software job, her friend dryly quips that without planning she might have become Prime Minister.
Urged by his friends to propose, Shannu daydreams a hyper-dramatic serial-style sob story from Vaishnavi and abruptly snaps back to reality terrified, blurting out that he will never propose.
After trying to lecture Vaishnavi on Marvel vs DC, Manohar and Don are left dumbfounded when she picks Mr. Bean as her superhero and leaves them wondering who gave KT to whom.

Having embarrassingly started dictating his phone number thinking Vaishnavi asked for it when she was actually asking Harika, Shannu desperately over-compensates by insisting repeatedly that he does not feel bad.
